definition.description: From a supine bilateral floor bridge, raise the hips through a comfortable active range. While the pelvis stays elevated, lift and replace one foot under control, then alternate sides. Finish by returning both feet to the floor and lowering under control. One cycle is one left and one right foot lift and replacement within the same elevated bridge. This excludes bilateral bridge repetitions, Hip Thrust, walkout, single-leg bridge repetitions, static hold, testing, forced range, and any undeclared load.
